title: Vox Language Rules — Phase 5: Effect System & Workflow Determinism (2026-05-09)
summary: Multi-quarter plan to land the effect system on every public fn, enforce @uses and @pure decorators transitively, and forbid non-deterministic builtins in workflow bodies.
notes: Document is a multi-quarter implementation plan with tasks (Task 1-6) and phased escalation rules. Contains SPEC-level technical prescriptions for effect checking (e.g., 'A function declared @uses(S) must have inferred set ⊆ S'), but presented as an execution roadmap with status=roadmap rather than as a reference contract. Classified as DOC (planning document) rather than SPEC because the primary purpose is execution guidance; the technical rules will likely be extracted into a formal SPEC later.
